scope: Ephemeral headless Google Chrome UI checks with remote requests blocked and synthetic empty storage. No device testing, clinical validation, translation validation or production publication.

checks.name: Global urgent support is visible before a mood choice; no universal telephone number is displayed
Mood selection updates accessible state and is not a stored or reassuring screening result
Shared evidence button opens source details and Escape returns keyboard focus to the trigger
STRAW entries produce descriptive text only and editing removes stale output
Native number input rejects a zero and announces an entry error; source sheet remains linked
Foot-care safety source opens with CDC and NHS references and no regimen is written to storage
Owned pages have no horizontal document overflow at 320px in dark theme and declare an English clinical-copy region
